facility.name: Future Minds
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 809 LENOX ST, WACO, TX, 76704

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: In the toddler room, disinfectant wipes and spray were being stored on shelves that were low enough for toddlers to reach. This was corrected during the inspection when the director hung a basket on the wall for caregivers to store their cleaning supplies out of reach.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: There were bottles of Clorox wipes in the toddler room and the pre-k room. This was corrected during the inspection when the bottles were moved out of reach.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: A caregiver did not wash hands after diapering a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Used According to Manufacturer's Instructions: There was a piece of climbing equipment on the front playground that was meant for indoor use only. This was corrected during the inspection when the equipment was removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Used According to Manufacturer's Instructions (26 TAC §746.4601(2))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Hand-washing Sink in Diaper Changing Area: There was no sink in the diaper changing area in the toddler room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Hand-washing Sink in Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3503(d))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Active Play Pre K - 90 Minutes of Moderate to Vigorous: The pre-k schedule did not have 90 minutes of physical activity on it.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Active Play Pre K - 90 Minutes of Moderate to Vigorous (26 TAC §746.2206(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A child did not have their hands washed after getting their diaper changed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: A playground checklist had not being completed for June. This was corrected during the inspection when the director checked the playground and completed a playground checklist.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Out of four children's records reviewed, one child needed an updated immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The children's product recall verification form was last signed in May 2024. This was corrected during the inspection when a new form was completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: One caregiver was missing four hours out of the required 24 hours of annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: One infant's feeding instructions had not been updated since May.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: In the infant room, children under the age of two were watching a television program on the caregiver's tablet. This was corrected during the inspection when the caregiver was informed that children under two cannot have screen time and the caregiver turned the tablet off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: There was a bottle of Clorox wipes and a bottle of Febreze on the shelves where children could reach. This was corrected during the inspection when the supplies were moved to a closet that the children could not access.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: One caregiver had only completed 12 out of the 24 required annual training hours and another caregiver had only completed 16 hours out of the 24 required annual training hours for the 2022-2023 training year. This was corrected during the inspection as the training period has ended and both caregivers have started obtaining their hours for the current year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Out of six children's files reviewed, five were missing admission dates, three school-age children were missing school information, and one school-age child was missing permission to ride the bus from school.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: One caregiver and the director had expired first aid and CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The center's operational policies did not address all of the topics required in minimum standards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit Incomplete Kit - Adhesive Tape: The first aid kit was missing adhesive tape.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit Incomplete Kit - Adhesive Tape (26 TAC §746.4003(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup: An infant was observed sleeping with a bottle. This was corrected during the inspection when a caregiver removed the bottle from the crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup (26 TAC §746.2419(7))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training: The director had only completed 9 out of the required 30 hours of annual training for the 2022-2023 training year. This was corrected during the inspection as the training period has ended and the director has already obtained over 30 training hours for the current year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink: During the inspection observed caregiver prepare a bottle on the diaper changing table and then change on diaper on the table.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.2419(8))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - If Above Floor Level Caregiver Must Face Child and Be Within Arm's Length of Child: During the inspection observed a caregiver change a diaper, turn her back and throw a diaper in trash can leaving infant buckled on diaper changing table.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - If Above Floor Level Caregiver Must Face Child and Be Within Arm's Length of Child (26 TAC §746.3503(c)(3))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: Observed two infants under 12 months old sleeping in playpens with blankets covering them. This was corrected by the caregivers removing the blankets.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Crib for Each Non-walking Infant Younger Than 12 Months of Age: During the inspection there were eight  infants observed sleeping, two infants did not have a crib/playpen and were observed sleeping in a bouncer. This was corrected by the director taking two playpens to the infant classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Crib for Each Non-walking Infant Younger Than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2405(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors -   Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing: 3 out of the 5 staff employed longer than 90 days and were present did not have a current certification in CPR/First AID
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors -   Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: Observed one infant sleeping in a bouncer with a blanket. This was corrected by the caregiver removing the infant and the blanket.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426)

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles: During the inspection a 9 month old was observed in a bouncer drinking a bottle that was propped up by a blanket.  This was corrected by the caregiver removing the bottle and taking the infant out of the bouncer.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles (26 TAC §746.2419(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: During the inspection the personnel files were missing, notarized affidavits, high school diplomas, and documentation of pre-service trainings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: During the inspection the playground was observed with a large tree limb hanging down from a tree and leaning on playground fence. Observed a sink cabinet accessible to children  containing rodent traps without a safety latch on the cabinet to prevent children in care from accessing items under sink. The traps were removed during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: During the inspection a outlet accessible to children under  5 years was observed uncovered. This was corrected by the outlet being covered with a safety cover.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: During the inspection a caregiver with a pending background check was accessible to children in care and counted in ratio. This was corrected by the caregiver leaving the operation and being replaced with  caregiver with a cleared background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
